Scope & method

This console evaluates synthetic or explicitly authorised test-log metadata only. It checks ordering, timing, sender identity, authentication outcomes, and key epoch freshness. It does not decrypt payloads, transmit data, or make network calls.

!
Before sharing an exported report, confirm the input log was authorised for this assessment and contains no sensitive payload content.
